title: Content Agent output (Phase 4)
description: Proposed Indonesian marketing drafts for ONE approved opportunity. Identifiers, status, timestamps, hashes, the authoritative placeholder list and claims_requiring_verification are assigned by code, never by the agent. Parsed strictly: unknown fields are rejected.

variant.description: 1..variants configured for the type in config/content.yaml

channel.description: one of the channels configured for the type

x-structural-rules: per type (config/content.yaml): required fields, allowed channels, rune limits per field (0 = field must be empty), body sections in order
at most `variants` drafts per type, numbered 1..variants without repeats; only requested types
x-code-gates: every evidence ref must be linked to this opportunity (opportunity_evidence) and still validated; otherwise the draft is blocked

brand checker, factual-claim scanner (prices, hours, addresses, statistics, customer claims, unsupported numbers) and content language rules run on hook, headline, body and call_to_action after [ISI: ...] markers are removed
fact claims without validated A-C evidence or an approved business fact are recorded as claims requiring verification
near-duplicates (same type and channel, token Jaccard >= duplicate_similarity) are reported and not stored
status: blocked | needs_review | draft; never approved on creation
